[[Eshwe's Wand]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Eshwe the Insane]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Joko's Domain]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Domination Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
